strings.큰 비커에 부어요. 두 비커 모두 빨강은 20mL로 똑같아요!: to pour it into the big one. Both beakers have exactly 20mL of red!
strings.그래서 빨강과 노랑의 비는?: So what is the ratio of red to yellow?
strings.멀리서 본 내 점: My dots seen from far away
strings.예) 빨강 20mL에 노랑 40mL를 부었을 때 …: e.g. When I poured 40mL of yellow into 20mL of red …
strings.손가락이나 마우스로 누른 채 끌어서: hold it down with your finger or mouse and drag it
strings.황금비의 앞 두 자리예요. 왼쪽부터 차례로 기억해 두세요!: These are the first two digits of the golden ratio. Remember them in order, left to right!
strings.목소리가 없어요(설치된 {{voiceCount}}개 모두 여성). 남자: voice ({{voiceCount}} installed, all female). Male characters need pre-made audio files —
see the notes in that folder.
strings.틀린 가설은 목록에서 지워 뒀어요: The ones proved wrong have been crossed off
strings.빨강은 한 컵, 노랑은 두 컵이 되었구나. 같은 양인데 세는 단위를 바꾸: So the red came to one cup and the yellow to two. The amounts are just the same, but change the unit you count in and new numbers appear. So what is the ratio of red to yellow? Choose below.
Hello! I am Ratia, and we are going to find the Secret of Ratio together.
strings.여기는 색깔의 비밀 방이에요. 도움이 필요한 화가와 과학자가 기다리고 있: This is the Color room. A painter and a scientist are waiting, and they need your help.
strings.노을 진 하늘을 칠하다 말았어요: The sunset sky was left half painted
strings.안녕? 나는 화가 뭉크야. 「절규」의 노을 진 하늘을 칠해야 하는데 물감: Hello there. I am Munch, a painter. I still have the sunset sky of The Scream to paint, but my paint has dried up.
strings.과학자 먼셀이 주황색을 만들어 주겠다고 했어. 너도 도와줄래?: Munsell the scientist said he would make the orange for me. Will you help too?
strings.먼셀 20색상환 — 빨강·주황·노랑·초록·파랑·보라 스무 가지 색이 원을: Munsell’s 20-hue color circle — twenty colors from red and orange through yellow, green, blue and purple, arranged in a ring with their names and values
Hello, good to meet you. I am Munsell, a scientist who studies color.
I am the one who put together this color circle.
strings.나와 함께 뭉크의 노을색을 만들어볼까?: Shall we make Munch’s sunset color together?
Let us find it by experiment.
strings.색을 결정하는 것은 무엇일까? 이 중 두 가지를 찾아봐. 아닌 것도 눌러: What decides a color? Find the two that do. You may tap the others to check as well.
strings.아닌 것 같은 것도 눌러 보세요 · 다시 눌러도 괜찮아요: Tap the ones you think are wrong too · you can tap again
Which paints you use does decide the color.
strings.다 섞이고 나면 순서는 상관없단다. 다시 한번 생각해볼까?: Once everything is mixed the order makes no difference. Shall we think again?
strings.붓의 크기는 칠할 때 필요한 것이란다. 다시 한번 생각해볼까?: The brush size matters when you paint, not when you mix. Shall we think again?
How much you put in decides the color too.
So which paints do we need? Look carefully at the target color and make a guess.
That is right. Those are the two.
strings.빨강과 파랑이 섞이면 보라색이 된단다. 다시 한번 생각해볼까?: Red and blue mixed together make purple. Shall we think again?
strings.노랑과 파랑이 섞이면 초록색이 된단다. 다시 한번 생각해볼까?: Yellow and blue mixed together make green. Shall we think again?
strings.좋아. 그럼 각각 물감의 양은 얼마나 넣어야 할까?: Good. So how much of each paint should go in?
strings.실험으로 알아내야 해요: We have to find out by experiment
strings.넣는 양이 달라지면 색도 달라진단다. 실험으로 확인해 볼까?: Change the amount and the color changes with it. Shall we check by experiment?
strings.양이 많아도 두 물감의 비가 다르면 색이 달라진단다. 실험으로 확인해 볼: Even with a lot of paint, a different ratio gives a different color. Shall we check by experiment?
strings.아래 두 비커에 빨강 물감을 20mL 넣었어. 여기에 노랑 물감을 다르게: I have put 20mL of red into both beakers below. Now we add different amounts of yellow: 20mL on the left, 60mL on the right. Watch what happens to the color.
strings.과학자는 실험 전에 가설을 세워. 가설은 어떻게 될지 미리 예상해 보는: A scientist makes a hypothesis before experimenting — a guess about what will happen. Look hard at the target color. Which paint looks like there is more of it? Choose, and we will test that hypothesis straight away.
strings.좋은 가설은 찍는 게 아니라 관찰에서 나와요 · 다시 골라도 괜찮아요: A good hypothesis comes from looking, not guessing · you can choose again
strings.🔴 빨강이 더 많아 보여요: 🔴 There looks to be more red
strings.빨강이 많으면 이렇게 진하고 붉은 주황이 된단다. 목표색과 나란히 놓고: With more red you get a deep, reddish orange like this. Shall we put it beside the target color?
strings.🟡 노랑이 더 많아 보여요: 🟡 There looks to be more yellow
strings.노랑이 많으면 이렇게 밝고 환한 주황이 된단다. 목표색과 나란히 놓고 비: With more yellow you get a bright, light orange like this. Shall we put it beside the target color?
strings.반반이면 딱 중간 주황이 된단다. 목표색과 나란히 놓고 비교해 볼까?: Half and half gives an orange right in the middle. Shall we put it beside the target color?
strings.목표색을 만들기 위해 빨강 물감 10mL씩 두 컵을 부었어. 노랑 물감은: To make the target color I have poured two cups of red, 10mL each. How many 10mL cups of yellow should go in? Pour it the way your hypothesis says. I will tell you the moment it matches the target.
strings.노랑 쪽 ＋를 눌러 한 컵씩 부어요: Tap ＋ on the yellow side to pour one cup at a time
strings.완벽해. 그런데 같은 색을 다른 양으로도 만들 수 있을까? 이번에는 빨강: Perfect. But can we make the same color with different amounts? This time I poured four cups of red, 10mL each. How many 10mL cups of yellow will give the same color as before?
strings.빨강이 두 배가 되었어요 · 노랑은 몇 컵일까요: The red has doubled · how many cups of yellow?
strings.빨강 20, 노랑 40으로 목표색을 찾았지? 이번에는 다른 양으로 목표색: You found the target color with 20 red and 40 yellow. Now make it with different amounts. Set the amounts with the sliders, and record it when you find it.
strings.미션 · 앞에서 만든 두 가지와 다른 양으로 목표색 만들기 · 슬라이더는: Mission · make the target color with amounts different from the two you already made · the sliders go up to 500mL
strings.만약 빨강 물감 20mL에도 빨강 30mL를 더 넣고,: What if you added 30mL of red to the 20mL of red,
strings.노랑 40mL에도 노랑 30mL를 더하면 빨강 50, 노랑 70이 되잖아: and 30mL of yellow to the 40mL of yellow? That would make 50 red and 70 yellow.
strings.이렇게 같은 양을 더해도 같은 색이 나오나요?: If you add the same amount to both, do you still get the same color?
strings.좋은 질문이야! 실험으로 보여 주자. 비커에는 빨강 20mL와 노랑 40: What a good question! Let us show it by experiment. The beaker holds 20mL of red and 40mL of yellow. Add 30mL to each side, just as Dain said. Will it match the target color?
strings.빨강도 세 컵, 노랑도 세 컵 더 부어요: Pour three more cups of red and three more of yellow
strings.아래 그림을 같이 볼까? 빨강:노랑에 같은 양을 각각 더했어. 그런데 다: Shall we look at the picture below? We added the same amount to red:yellow, and the color came out different. Drag the word cards to finish an explanation for your friend.
strings.실험으로 찾은 빨강 20mL와 노랑 40mL를 다시 가져왔어. 이번에는: Here are the 20mL of red and 40mL of yellow you found by experiment. This time I will give you a slightly bigger cup that holds 20mL. If you move all the paint from both beakers into these cups, how many cups will each one fill? Tap the cups and move it across yourself.
strings.빈 컵을 누르면 비커에서 20mL가 옮겨져요: Tap an empty cup and 20mL moves across from the beaker
strings.🤔 방금 한 일을 짚어 볼까: 🤔 Let us look back at what you just did
strings.어떻게 해서 1컵과 2컵이 되었나요?: How did it come out as 1 cup and 2 cups?
strings.20mL짜리 컵으로 두 비커를 모두 옮겨 담았어요: I moved both beakers across using 20mL cups
strings.빨강을 덜어 내고 노랑을 더 넣었어요: I took some red out and put more yellow in
strings.물감은 한 방울도 덜어 내거나 더 넣지 않았단다. 세는 단위만 바꾸었지?: Not one drop was taken out or added. All that changed was the unit you counted in.
strings.양은 그대로인데 왜 1과 2라는 새로운 수가 보였을까요?: The amounts did not change, so why did the new numbers 1 and 2 appear?
strings.20mL를 한 묶음으로 세었기 때문이에요: Because we counted in bundles of 20mL
The paint only moved from beaker to cup — none of it went away.
strings.컵이 비커보다 작기 때문이에요: Because the cup is smaller than the beaker
strings.컵이 작다는 것만으로는 1과 2가 나오지 않는단다. 무엇을 한 묶음으로: A smaller cup on its own does not give you 1 and 2. Shall we look again at what size bundle you counted in?
strings.손으로 옮긴 이 일을 기호로 쓰면 어느 것일까요?: Which symbols say what you just did with your hands?
strings.두 양을 더한 값이란다. 우리가 한 일은 두 양을 견주어 본 것이지?: That is the two amounts added together. What we did was compare them, was it not?
strings.두 양의 차란다. 우리가 한 일은 두 양을 견주어 본 것이지?: That is the difference between the two amounts. What we did was compare them, was it not?
strings.마지막이야. 빨강 40mL와 노랑 80mL를 40mL짜리 컵으로 옮겨 담: Last one. Move 40mL of red and 80mL of yellow into cups that hold 40mL. How many cups to how many cups this time?
strings.양이 달라도 전부 같은 색이었어. 모두 간단히 하면 언제나 1 대 2였어: Every one of them was the same color, whatever the amounts. Simplified, they all came to 1 to 2. What should we write in the notebook?
Whatever the amounts, keep this ratio and you get the same color.
strings.양만 적어 두면 더 많이 만들 때는 쓸 수 없단다. 다시 한번 생각해볼까: Write down only the amounts and it is no use when you want to make more. Shall we think again?
strings.이제 빨강과 노랑을 몇 대 몇의 비율로 섞으면 그 색이 만들어지는지 뭉크: Now write to Munch and tell him what ratio of red to yellow makes the color. Hold the number cards below and drag them onto the blanks.
strings.빨강과 노랑을 1 대 2로 섞으면 그 색이 나오는구나. 알아내줘서 고마워: So mixing red and yellow 1 to 2 gives that color. Thank you for working it out! I have put 50mL of red in the big tub. How much yellow should go in?
strings.10mL 컵으로 노랑을 부어요: Pour the yellow with the 10mL cup
I painted the sunset with the color you gave me, and it is finished.
strings.지금까지 \\'뭉크\\'와 \\'먼셀\\'을 도와 색을 만드는 비의 비밀: So far you have helped Munch and Munsell and worked out the secret of ratio in mixing color. Well done!
Now we are going to make color a different way.
strings.이때도 비의 비밀이 숨어 있대요. 같이 알아볼까요?: They say the Secret of Ratio is hiding here too. Shall we go and find it?
strings.폴 시냐크, 「펠릭스 페네옹의 초상」(1890) · 「양산을 든 여인: Paul Signac, Portrait of Félix Fénéon (1890)  ·  Woman with a Parasol — unfinished, with the orange missing
Hello. I am Signac, a painter who makes color out of dots.
strings.그런데 지금 「양산을 든 여인」을 그릴 때 필요한 주황색을 만드는 중이야: Right now I am mixing the orange I need for Woman with a Parasol.
strings.같이 점을 찍으며 색을 만드는 걸 도와주겠니?: Will you help me make the color, dot by dot?
strings.나는 빨강 2개와 노랑 3개가 섞인 주황을 만들고 싶어. 위에서 물감을: I want an orange made of 2 reds and 3 yellows. Pick a paint at the top, then tap an empty square below to place a dot. Tap it again to rub a dot out.
strings.🤔 방금 찍은 점을 짚어 볼까: 🤔 Let us look back at the dots you just placed
strings.어떻게 해서 이 주황이 되었나요?: How did this orange come about?
strings.빨강 점 2개와 노랑 점 3개를 찍었어요: I placed 2 red dots and 3 yellow dots
strings.아무 색이나 다섯 개를 찍었어요: I placed any five dots at all
strings.색을 아무렇게나 찍으면 이 주황이 안 나와. 각 색을 몇 개씩 찍었는지: Dots placed at random do not give this orange. Shall we count how many of each color you placed?
strings.왜 점의 개수가 색을 정할까요?: Why does the number of dots decide the color?
strings.전체에서 각 색이 차지하는 몫이 정해지기 때문이에요: Because it fixes each color’s share of the whole
strings.점이 많을수록 색이 진해지기 때문이에요: Because more dots make a deeper color
strings.점을 많이 찍어도 두 색의 비가 같으면 같은 주황이야. 다시 생각해볼까?: However many dots you place, the same ratio gives the same orange. Shall we think again?
strings.내가 찍은 점을 기호로 쓰면 어느 것일까요?: Which symbols say what your dots show?
strings.앞에는 빨강 점 수, 뒤에는 노랑 점 수를 놓는 거야. 순서를 다시 볼까: The red dots go first, the yellow dots second. Shall we check the order?
strings.전체는 다섯 개야. 지금 견준 건 빨강과 노랑이지?: The whole is five. What you compared just now was red against yellow, was it not?
strings.이번엔 새로운 주황이야. 빨강 대 노랑을 2 대 3으로, 열 칸에 나타내: Here is a new orange. Show red to yellow as 2 to 3 across ten squares — 4 red and 6 yellow.
strings.마지막으로 백 칸에 도전해 봐, 큰 붓을 쓰면 한 줄씩 칠할 수 있어!: Last of all, try a hundred squares. With the big brush you can paint a whole row at a time!
strings.🤔 방금 칠한 백 칸을 짚어 볼까: 🤔 Let us look back at the hundred squares you painted
strings.백 칸을 어떻게 칠했나요?: How did you paint the hundred squares?
strings.빨강 40칸, 노랑 60칸으로 나누어 칠했어요: I split them into 40 red and 60 yellow
strings.한 칸씩 아무 데나 칠했어요: I painted squares here and there, one at a time
strings.칠한 자리는 달라도 좋아. 그런데 각 색을 몇 칸 칠했는지가 색을 정하지: Where you paint them can vary. What decides the color is how many squares of each. Shall we count again?
strings.칸이 열 칸에서 백 칸으로 늘었는데 왜 같은 주황일까요?: The squares went from ten to a hundred, so why is it the same orange?
strings.칸 수가 늘어도 빨강과 노랑의 비가 2 대 3 그대로이기 때문이에요: Because however many squares there are, red to yellow stays 2 to 3
strings.칸이 많아져서 색이 더 진해졌기 때문이에요: Because more squares made the color deeper
strings.칸이 많아져도 색은 그대로였지? 무엇이 변하지 않았는지 다시 볼까?: The color stayed the same with more squares, did it not? Shall we look again at what did not change?
strings.백 칸에 칠한 것을 기호로 쓰면 어느 것일까요?: Which symbols say what you painted on the hundred squares?
strings.40과 100은 빨강과 전체를 견준 거야. 지금은 빨강과 노랑을 견주고: 40 and 100 compares red with the whole. Right now we are comparing red with yellow.
strings.두 수를 더한 값이야. 우리가 한 일은 두 양을 견주어 본 것이지?: That is the two numbers added together. What we did was compare them, was it not?
Does placing more red and yellow dots make the color redder? Compare the two pictures. Which orange is the redder one?
strings.㉮ — 빨강 칸이 여덟 칸으로 더 많으니까: A — because it has more red squares, eight of them
strings.빨강 칸은 여덟 칸으로 더 많아. 그런데 노랑도 열두 칸이나 있지. 전체: It does have more red, eight squares. But it also has twelve yellow. Shall we compare red’s share of the whole?
strings.㉯ — 빨강이 차지하는 몫이 더 크니까: B — because red takes up a bigger share
That is right. What decides the color is not the number of squares but the share of the whole.
strings.㉮는 스무 칸 중 여덟 칸, ㉯는 여섯 칸 중 세 칸이야. 반이 넘는 쪽: A is eight out of twenty, B is three out of six. Which one is more than half?
strings.점의 개수가 늘어나도 빨강과 노랑의 비는 그대로 2 대 3이었지!: However many more dots there were, red to yellow stayed 2 to 3!
Thank you for letting me practise the color I wanted and get my painting done.
strings.시냐크와 함께 점을 찍어 주황을 표현해냈군요! 잘했어요!: You made orange out of dots with Signac. Well done!
strings.지금부터는 비율을 공부해볼까요?: Now shall we look at rate?
strings.100칸 중 빨강으로 칠해진 칸은 40칸이에요. 전체 100칸에 대한 빨: Of the 100 squares, 40 are painted red. What is red’s share of all 100 squares? Hold the words below with your finger or mouse, drag them and drop them on the blanks.
strings.이어서 비율 문제예요. 만약 물감 빨강 40mL, 노랑 60mL을 넣어: Here is another one. If 40mL of red and 60mL of yellow make 100mL of orange, what per cent of the whole is each color?
strings.지금까지 한 일을 떠올려 봐요. 빨강 20mL에 노랑 40mL를 부어 목: Think back over everything you did. You made the target color by pouring 40mL of yellow into 20mL of red, and when the red grew to 40mL you poured 80mL of yellow. Moved into cups it always came to 1 cup against 2 cups, and whether you placed five dots or painted a hundred squares, each color kept the same share. Using what you did here in the Color room, explain why different amounts still gave the same color.
strings.아래에 내가 만든 양이 남아 있어요 · 그중 하나를 예로 들어 적어요: The amounts you made are still below · write about one of them
strings.여러분이 적은 내용을 잘 보았어요. 물감과 컵, 점과 칸으로 비를 공부해: I have read what you wrote. You have studied ratio with paint and cups, with dots and squares. Now let us pull it together. Drag the word cards into the blanks.
strings.색깔의 비밀을 잘 찾아냈어요! 카드 숫자 1과 6을 차례로 얻었어요! 잘: You found the Color secret! You have earned the card numbers 1 and 6, in that order. Keep them safe!

is the same you get the same color.
strings.양이 달라도 비가 같으면 같은 색!: Different amounts, same ratio — the same color!
strings.조작물을 다시 보면서 생각해 볼까?: Shall we look at it again and think?
strings.빨강과 노랑을 둘 다 넣어야 섞을 수 있단다. 둘 다 넣고 실험해 볼까?: You need both red and yellow before anything can mix. Shall we put both in and try?
strings.같은 양을 더해 보았어요: You added the same amount to each
You added 30mL to the red and 30mL to the yellow, exactly the same, and the color changed. Put it beside the target color and compare.
strings.mL로 맞춰 보자: mL — let us set it to that
strings.다인이가 말한 대로 빨강에도 30mL, 노랑에도 30mL를 더 넣어 볼까: Shall we add 30mL to the red and 30mL to the yellow, just as Dain said?
strings.가설이 틀렸다는 걸 알아냈어요!: You found out the hypothesis was wrong!
strings.틀린 가설을 지우는 것도 중요한 발견이에요. 아래에서 새 가설을 골라 봐: Crossing off a wrong hypothesis is an important discovery too. Choose a new one below.
strings.노랑을 더 넣으면 색이 밝고 환해진단다. 조금 더 넣어 볼까?: More yellow makes the color lighter and brighter. Shall we add a little more?
strings.노랑이 조금 많은 것 같구나. 노랑을 조금 덜어 볼까?: That looks like a little too much yellow. Shall we take some out?
strings.빨강을 더 넣으면 색이 진하고 붉어진단다. 조금 더 넣어 볼까?: More red makes the color deeper and redder. Shall we add a little more?
strings.아직 목표 색이 아니란다. 내 색과 목표 색을 나란히 놓고 비교해 볼까?: Not the target color yet. Shall we put your color beside the target and compare?
strings.두 물감에 같은 양을 더하면 비가 달라진단다. 몇 배로 늘리는 방법을 생: Adding the same amount to both changes the ratio. Shall we think about multiplying instead?
strings.노랑만 한 컵씩 바꾸면 색이 변하는 방향이 보인단다. 천천히 시험해 볼까: Change the yellow one cup at a time and you can see which way the color goes. Shall we try it slowly?
Change one paint at a time with the ＋ button, 10mL at a step, and you can see which way the color goes. Shall we try it slowly?
strings.찾았다! 목표 색이에요: Found it! That is the target color
strings.가설이 딱 맞았어요 — 진짜 과학자!: Your hypothesis was spot on — a real scientist!
It came out differently from your hypothesis, but the experiment settled it.
strings.이미 실험한 양이에요: You have already tried those amounts
strings.성공! 양은 달라도 같은 색이에요: Success! Different amounts, the same color
strings., 처음 찾은 비 그대로예요!: , exactly the ratio you found at the start!
strings.빨강은 똑같이 20mL인데!: And yet the red is 20mL in both!
strings.노랑 비커가 1개일 때와 3개일 때 색이 완전히 달라요. 두 물감의 양을: One yellow beaker and three yellow beakers give completely different colors. You have to look at both amounts!
strings.비커가 비었단다. 다른 비커의 물감도 옮겨 담아 볼까?: That beaker is empty. Shall we move the paint from the other one too?
strings.물감의 양은 그대로인데: The amount of paint has not changed, but counting in units of
mL brings out new numbers. Choose the ratio below.
Different amounts, but bundle them into the right cups and it is 1 to 2 all over again.
strings.이번에는 컵에 모으면서 몇 컵이 되는지 세어 볼까?: Shall we gather it into cups this time and count how many there are?
strings.먼저 컵으로 옮겨 담아 볼까?: Shall we move it into the cups first?
strings.한 컵을 비커로 되돌렸어: One cup went back into the beaker
strings.되돌리기는 여기까지야. 이제 컵에 모으면서 세어 볼까?: That is as far as undo goes. Now shall we gather it into cups and count?
strings.비커에 물감이 남아 있어: There is still paint in the beaker
strings.아직 비커에 물감이 남아 있단다. 남은 물감도 컵으로 옮겨 담아 볼까?: There is still paint in the beaker. Shall we move the rest into cups as well?
strings.노랑 비커에 물감이 더 많이 남아 있단다. 노랑부터 이어서 옮겨 볼까?: There is more left in the yellow beaker. Shall we carry on with the yellow?
strings.거의 다 왔단다. 남은 물감을 마저 옮겨 비커를 비워 볼까?: Almost there. Shall we move the last of it and empty the beaker?
strings.mL만 담긴단다. 한쪽 비커를 끝까지 비우고 다른 쪽을 옮기면 세기 쉬워: mL. Empty one beaker right out before starting the other and it is easier to count.
strings.컵 수로 비를 말해 보자: Now say the ratio in cups
strings.컵을 다 옮겼구나. 빨강 컵과 노랑 컵을 하나씩 짚으며 세어 볼까?: Every cup is filled. Shall we point at the red cups and the yellow cups and count them one by one?
strings.비는 앞에 빨강 컵 수, 뒤에 노랑 컵 수를 놓는단다. 그 차례대로 골라: In a ratio the red cups come first and the yellow cups second. Shall we choose in that order?
strings.두 컵 수를 합하지 말고, 색깔별 컵 수를 그대로 나란히 놓아 보면 된단: Do not add the two counts together — set the count for each color side by side.
strings.20mL와 40mL를 20mL씩 묶어 세면 1컵과 2컵 — 양은 그대로인: Bundle 20mL and 40mL into 20mL cups and you get 1 cup and 2 cups. The amounts never changed, but changing the unit brought 1 : 2 into view!
strings.컵을 하나씩 짚으며 세어 보자. 빨강 컵과 노랑 컵이 각각 몇 개인지 다: Point at each cup as you count. Shall we count the red cups and the yellow cups again?
strings.비는 앞에 빨강 컵 수, 뒤에 노랑 컵 수를 놓는단다. 순서를 다시 볼까: In a ratio the red cups come first and the yellow cups second. Shall we check the order?
strings.두 색의 컵을 합한 수가 아니라 색깔별 컵 수를 세는 거란다. 노랑 컵만: It is not the two counts added together — it is how many cups of each color. Shall we count just the yellow cups again?
strings.빨강 컵 수를 앞에, 노랑 컵 수를 뒤에 그대로 놓으면 된단다. 컵 그림: Put the red cup count first and the yellow cup count second. Shall we look at the cups and choose?
strings.= 2 : 3 — 점의 비로 주황을 만들었어요!: = 2 : 3 — you made orange out of a ratio of dots!
strings.이란다. 점의 수를 바꿔 한 번 더 만들어 볼까?: . Shall we change the number of dots and try again?
strings.칸이야. 목표인 2 : 3과 나란히 놓고 비교해 볼까?: squares. Shall we put it beside the target 2 : 3 and compare?
strings.빨강이 2 : 3보다 조금 모자라 보여. 빨강을 늘려서 다시 칠해 볼까?: That looks a little short of red for 2 : 3. Shall we add red and paint again?
strings.빨강이 2 : 3보다 조금 많아 보여. 빨강을 줄여서 다시 칠해 볼까?: That looks a little heavy on red for 2 : 3. Shall we take red away and paint again?
strings.2 : 3은 빨강 두 묶음, 노랑 세 묶음이니 전체가 다섯 묶음이야. 전: 2 : 3 means two bundles of red and three of yellow, so five bundles in all. How about splitting the squares into five equal bundles?
strings.2배씩 늘리면 — 같은 색!: Double them both — the same color!
strings.세 컵씩 똑같이 더하면\\n색이 달라요:
Add three cups to each
and the color changes
strings.색깔의 비밀을 문장으로 정리했어요. 허브로 돌아가 다음 탐험을 이어가요!: You have put the Color secret into words. Head back and carry on with the next adventure!
strings.이 값이면 이런 색이 된단다: These amounts give a color like this
strings.그 값이면 이런 색이 된단다. 목표 색과 비교해 볼까?: Those amounts give a color like this. Shall we compare it with the target?
strings.차이가 같아도 비가 다르면 색이 달라진단다. 몇 배인지로 생각해 볼까?: The same difference but a different ratio gives a different color. Shall we think in terms of how many times instead?
strings.실험 기록장의 ⭕ 양들을 간단히 하면 힌트가 된단다. 다시 살펴볼까?: Simplify the ⭕ amounts in your log and you have a hint. Shall we look again?
strings.⭕ 기록을 간단히 하면 언제나 같은 비가 된단다. 그 비를 다시 놓아 볼: Simplify the ⭕ records and they always come to the same ratio. Shall we put that ratio down again?
